module.name: holoscan-recorder
module.description: Records named streams of a Holoscan graph (images of any pixel format, or tensors, in host or device memory) to disk with their capture times, without holding the graph back, and replays them deterministically: as fast as possible and lossless for tests, in real time by the recorded timestamps, or looped, over a frame range and stream subset, into host or device memory. Also replays stereo camera recordings (PGM/PPM with index.csv) read-only.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK, for device-memory streams and pinned host memory.
